criteria.observation: Both callers and the public application function produce the documented content, order, freshness and path semantics on POSIX and Windows selections through the chosen library.
An explicit fallback invokes the preserved version1 library and both application callers return compatible manifests.
The initial and follow-up diffs plus calls show whether a vendor result-format change forces either application caller to reinterpret library fields.

After the published change in dependency shape, conversion can be updated at its owning boundary while the fixed application checks and rollback still pass. Credit observed change propagation independent of file count.
